import static org.junit.Assert.*;

  @org.junit.Rule
  public org.evosuite.runtime.vnet.NonFunctionalRequirementRule nfr = new org.evosuite.runtime.vnet.NonFunctionalRequirementRule();

  private org.evosuite.runtime.StandardStreams.Snapshot standardStreams = null;
  private org.evosuite.runtime.thread.ThreadStopper threadStopper =  new org.evosuite.runtime.thread.ThreadStopper (org.evosuite.runtime.thread.KillSwitchHandler.getInstance(), 3000);

  @Before
  public void initTestCase(){ 
    threadStopper.storeCurrentThreads();
    threadStopper.startRecordingTime();
    standardStreams = org.evosuite.runtime.StandardStreams.save(); 
    org.evosuite.runtime.GuiSupport.setHeadless(); 
  } 

  @After
  public void doneWithTestCase(){ 
    try { 
      threadStopper.killAndJoinClientThreads(); 
    } finally { 
      try { 
        org.evosuite.runtime.StandardStreams.restore(standardStreams); 
      } finally { 
        org.evosuite.runtime.GuiSupport.restoreHeadlessMode(); 
      } 
    } 
  }

    classStandardStreams = org.evosuite.runtime.StandardStreams.save(); 
    org.evosuite.runtime.RuntimeSettings.className = ""; 
    org.evosuite.runtime.GuiSupport.setHeadless(); 
    org.evosuite.runtime.GuiSupport.initialize(); 
    org.evosuite.runtime.RuntimeSettings.maxNumberOfIterationsPerLoop = 10000; 
    org.evosuite.runtime.RuntimeSettings.maxCumulativeArrayBytes = 400000000L; 
    org.evosuite.runtime.RuntimeSettings.maxMockInvocationsPerTest = 10000; 
    org.evosuite.runtime.RuntimeSettings.mockSystemIn = true; 
    org.evosuite.runtime.RuntimeSettings.sandboxMode = org.evosuite.runtime.sandbox.Sandbox.SandboxMode.RECOMMENDED; 
    org.evosuite.runtime.sandbox.Sandbox.initializeSecurityManagerForSUT(); 
    executor = Executors.newCachedThreadPool(); 
    org.evosuite.runtime.LoopCounter.getInstance().reset(); 
  } 

  @AfterClass
  public static void clearEvoSuiteFramework(){ 
    try { 
      try { 
        Sandbox.resetDefaultSecurityManager(); 
      } finally { 
        executor.shutdownNow(); 
      } 
    } finally { 
      org.evosuite.runtime.StandardStreams.restore(classStandardStreams); 
    } 
  }

  public void initTestCase(){ 
    threadStopper.storeCurrentThreads();
    threadStopper.startRecordingTime();
    org.evosuite.runtime.sandbox.Sandbox.goingToExecuteSUTCode(); 
    standardStreams = org.evosuite.runtime.StandardStreams.save(); 
    org.evosuite.runtime.GuiSupport.setHeadless(); 
  } 

  @After

import org.evosuite.runtime.annotation.EvoSuiteClassExclude;
import org.junit.BeforeClass;
import org.junit.Before;
import org.junit.After;
import org.junit.AfterClass;
import org.evosuite.runtime.sandbox.Sandbox;
import org.evosuite.runtime.sandbox.Sandbox.SandboxMode;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;
import java.util.concurrent.Future;

@EvoSuiteClassExclude
public class GoldenTest_scaffolding {

  @org.junit.Rule
  public org.evosuite.runtime.vnet.NonFunctionalRequirementRule nfr = new org.evosuite.runtime.vnet.NonFunctionalRequirementRule();

  private org.evosuite.runtime.StandardStreams.Snapshot standardStreams = null;
  private static org.evosuite.runtime.StandardStreams.Snapshot classStandardStreams = null;
  protected static ExecutorService executor; 

  private org.evosuite.runtime.thread.ThreadStopper threadStopper =  new org.evosuite.runtime.thread.ThreadStopper (org.evosuite.runtime.thread.KillSwitchHandler.getInstance(), 3000);


  @BeforeClass
  public static void initEvoSuiteFramework() { 
    classStandardStreams = org.evosuite.runtime.StandardStreams.save(); 
    org.evosuite.runtime.RuntimeSettings.className = ""; 
    org.evosuite.runtime.GuiSupport.setHeadless(); 
    org.evosuite.runtime.GuiSupport.initialize(); 
    org.evosuite.runtime.RuntimeSettings.maxNumberOfIterationsPerLoop = 10000; 
    org.evosuite.runtime.RuntimeSettings.maxCumulativeArrayBytes = 400000000L; 
    org.evosuite.runtime.RuntimeSettings.maxMockInvocationsPerTest = 10000; 
    org.evosuite.runtime.RuntimeSettings.mockSystemIn = true; 
    org.evosuite.runtime.RuntimeSettings.sandboxMode = org.evosuite.runtime.sandbox.Sandbox.SandboxMode.RECOMMENDED; 
    org.evosuite.runtime.sandbox.Sandbox.initializeSecurityManagerForSUT(); 
    executor = Executors.newCachedThreadPool(); 
    org.evosuite.runtime.LoopCounter.getInstance().reset(); 
  } 

  @AfterClass
  public static void clearEvoSuiteFramework(){ 
    try { 
      try { 
        Sandbox.resetDefaultSecurityManager(); 
      } finally { 
        executor.shutdownNow(); 
      } 
    } finally { 
      org.evosuite.runtime.StandardStreams.restore(classStandardStreams); 
    } 
  } 

  @Before
  public void initTestCase(){ 
    threadStopper.storeCurrentThreads();
    threadStopper.startRecordingTime();
    org.evosuite.runtime.sandbox.Sandbox.goingToExecuteSUTCode(); 
    standardStreams = org.evosuite.runtime.StandardStreams.save(); 
    org.evosuite.runtime.GuiSupport.setHeadless(); 
  } 

  @After
  public void doneWithTestCase(){ 
    try { 
      threadStopper.killAndJoinClientThreads(); 
    } finally { 
      try { 
        org.evosuite.runtime.StandardStreams.restore(standardStreams); 
      } finally { 
        try { 
          org.evosuite.runtime.sandbox.Sandbox.doneWithExecutingSUTCode(); 
        } finally { 
          org.evosuite.runtime.GuiSupport.restoreHeadlessMode(); 
        } 
      } 
    } 
  } 


  private static void initializeClasses() {
  } 
}
